RemediationStrings.Title: Security agent is not running
RemediationStrings.Description: The required security agent service is stopped or missing. Restart the device or contact the service desk.

RemediationStrings.Title: Windows PowerShell 2.0 is enabled
RemediationStrings.Description: Windows PowerShell 2.0 must be removed. IT will remediate this automatically; contact the service desk if it persists.
